15.t: The Game PC Board Assy is fitted with 4 Option Switches.
Switch 1 is used to change between Test Mode and Game Mode.
ON:   Test Mode   OFF:   Game Mode
Switch 2 is used to set the output level of the video signal.
Switch 3 is used to change the monitor Sync Frequency

Note: When using a 31kHz monitor, set the RGB input of the monitor to 0.7v. If the monitor does not have a setting adjustment, refer to page 17 section 6-2-1 “Display Test”, and change the Contrast and RGB Brightness levels to adjust the brightness.
Switch 4 is used to set the Video Sync Signal
ON:   Composite Sync   OFF:   Seperate Sync
Note: The game must be switched OFF and back ON for changes to switches 2,3, and 4 to take effect.
